message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and image files directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Model weights and data are loaded from local hardcoded paths with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks; no remote fetching with integrity controls is present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only calls value_counts() for informational display but performs no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool is used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The normalize() function filters visually dark/bright images for statistics computation only and is not called in the main data pipeline; no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or poisoning defenses are applied to training samples before use.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via torch.load() with hardcoded file paths but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check before loading the weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code calls `data['label'].value_counts()` but only as a display/inspection call with no assertion, threshold check, or validation logic enforcing class balance or expected label set.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard ASGD optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied to the training process.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The validation split is derived from the same training CSV with no held-out test isolation, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and the code only references a single accuracy/loss metric without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: Images are read and normalized directly without any shape, range, or type validation before being fed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs (e.g., NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation) are present anywhere in the inference path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision (image classification) pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
